svg.aria-label: Policies as code: the hub Argo CD renders Policy, Placement and PlacementBinding from Git into the namespace acm-policies. ACM propagates a replicated policy per selected cluster, the policy framework on the managed cluster evaluates and enforces it, and the compliance status flows back to the ACM governance view and, with health checks, to Argo CD.
